title: Federal Realty to Present at BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Federal Realty Investment Trust's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
NORTH BETHESDA, Md.


, Sept. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Federal Realty Investment Trust](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771547-1&h=1401195083&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.federalrealty.com%2F&a=Federal+Realty+Investment+Trust) announced today that the Company's management team is scheduled to participate in the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 1:30 PM ET.


**Event:** Federal Realty Presentation at the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference


**When:** 1:30 PM ET, Wednesday, September 16, 2026


**Live Webcast:**[FRT BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference Presentation](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771547-1&h=3947465022&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbofa.veracast.com%2Fwebcasts%2Fbofa%2Frealestate2026%2FIGd99q.cfm&a=FRT+BofA+Securities+2026+Global+Real+Estate+Conference+Presentation) or under the Investors tab at[www.federalrealty.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771547-1&h=3505048743&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.federalrealty.com%2F&a=www.federalrealty.com)


A replay of the webcast will be available within 24 hours after the conclusion of the live event on Federal Realty's website at[www.federalrealty.com](http://www.federalrealty.com/) through September 16, 2027.


**About Federal Realty**


Federal Realty is a recognized leader in the ownership, operation and redevelopment of high-quality retail-based properties located primarily in major coastal markets and select underserved regions with strong economic and demographic fundamentals. Founded in 1962, Federal Realty's mission is to deliver long-term, sustainable growth through investing in communities where retail demand exceeds supply. This includes a portfolio of open-air shopping centers and mixed-use destinations—such as Santana Row, Pike & Rose, and Assembly Row—which together reflect the company's ability to create distinctive, high-performing environments that serve as vibrant destinations for their communities. Federal Realty's 103 properties include approximately 3,700 tenants in 28.8 million commercial square feet, and approximately 2,700 residential units.


Federal Realty has increased its quarterly dividends per common share for 59 consecutive years on an annualized basis, the longest record in the REIT industry. Federal Realty is an S&P 500 index member and its shares are traded on the NYSE under the symbol FRT. For additional information about Federal Realty and its properties, visit[www.federalrealty.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771547-1&h=3505048743&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.federalrealty.com%2F&a=www.federalrealty.com) .
